consolidates.rule: parts accepted by bill are kept verbatim in substance; only the remaining R3..R7 items and the closed solver choice are changed

generated_manifest.per_path_npz_hashes: verified against the manifest before any read
generated_manifest.hidden_use: regime values at the preselected rows only, read by the state-target builder; never by the sampler, encoder, forward-risk or retrieval code

real_raw.source_received_at: 2026-11-06T12:02:16 (file field; KST assumed, recorded as such)

real_adj.source_received_at: 2026-11-06T11:54:53 (file field; KST assumed, recorded as such)

flybrake_reference.reused: wiring semantics (row-normalised PN->KC; per-row rewiring preserving each KC input degree and weight multiset, not PN out-degree totals) and sparse top-k code semantics; nothing else is imported or reused

time_model_R6.design: session-index model time: every record carries the session index D and the session label string from the file; no real-date confirmation is claimed for any session; no special-session calendar is used or claimed

timestamps_kept_apart.per_file_receipt: raw 2026-11-06T12:02:16 and adj 2026-11-06T11:54:53 are both retained verbatim
timestamps_kept_apart.trimming_cutoff: the EARLIEST receipt (adj 11:54:53) is used only to trim unfinished rows: the last retained session index is index(2026-11-05); the 2026-11-06 row is dropped
timestamps_kept_apart.input_receipt: the MAXIMUM receipt (raw 12:02:16) is recorded as input_receipt_at of the whole input set; it is not an availability claim for any decision time

time_model_R6.modeled_availability_for_ordering: decision_at(D) = model confirmation of session D = close(D) + 60 s under a declared ordinary-session assumption; availability(E_close20 at D) = close(D+20) + 60 s; used only to order availability inside model time; all records carry vintage_mode retrospective_latest_vintage

frozen_cutoffs.admissibility: a label at D is admissible for a fit at cutoff c iff D + 20 <= c (equivalently availability(D) <= decision_at(c) in model time)

time_model_R6.evaluation_cutoff_R2: data end = index(2026-11-05); an outcome at D is scorable iff D + 20 <= data end; predictions for later D are written as unscored with counts and never counted as negatives; the same rule applies to F2 query outcomes

eligibility_and_masks_R5.feature_eligible: council_io.features status ok (>= 200 closes, finite, sd20 > 0)
eligibility_and_masks_R5.encoder_abstain: a row abstains for an encoder when its pre-top-k activation has no positive entry (zero code)
eligibility_and_masks_R5.paired_comparison_mask: rows that are feature-eligible AND target-scorable (maturity rule of the task) AND non-abstaining under BOTH the connectome and the rewired encoder; every compared method (Fly-connectome, Fly-rewired, native logistic, LightGBM, prior constants) is fitted and scored on this same mask
eligibility_and_masks_R5.reported_separately: feature-eligible count, abstentions per encoder, intersection (mask) size, coverage per split/fold; any native full-coverage result is a separately labelled diagnostic and never the comparison
eligibility_and_masks_R5.label_blind_sampling_accepted: state rows chosen by fixed stride over each path's feature-eligible indices before any hidden label is read: m = 256 per train path, 64 per check/test path; stride = max(1, floor(n_eligible / m)); positions eligible[0], eligible[stride], ... (nonuniform end coverage accepted); rows later removed by the paired mask are dropped, never resampled; selected indices and counts recorded; maximum 15,360 train and 2,560 evaluation rows

encoder_R4.scaler: per-feature mean and population std on feature-eligible real sessions with D <= 3031; float64 arrays stored; abort if any std == 0
encoder_R4.projection_P: shape 344 x 10, entries N(0, 1/10) (standard deviation 1/sqrt(10)), from numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([20261107, 80, 0])), stored float64, used float32

wirings.connectome: W = row-normalised PN->KC weights from mb_right.npz (flybrake.wiring semantics re-implemented; rows without input stay zero)
wirings.rewired: per-row rewiring that preserves each KC row's input degree and weight multiset, from default_rng(SeedSequence([20261107, 87, 0])), then the same row normalisation; shares P, scaler, data order and readout initialisation with the connectome variant

encoder_R4.activation: x_scaled = (V_D - mean) / std (float64) -> float32; pn = relu(x_scaled @ P.T); a = pn @ W.T (theta = 0); top-k with k = 129 by stable descending sort on a with lower KC index first on ties; keep only positive entries among the k; z = kept / (||kept||2 + 1e-12); no positive entry -> abstain
encoder_R4.dtypes_and_storage: codes stored sparse: int16 KC indices and float32 values (<= 129 each); dense activations exist only per batch of <= 1,024 rows; caches work/council_phase1_pilot_v1/codes/{version_id}/{real|path_id}.npz written once (xb)
encoder_R4.identity: encoder_version_id = sha256 over (encoder code version string, feature order list, scaler mean and std bytes, P bytes, W bytes, theta bytes, k, epsilon 1e-12, dtype names, connectome file sha256); recorded with every cache and result; two versions; one variant processed at a time

readout_solver_closed_choice.model: offline logistic readout on the fixed sparse Fly code (not the original online avoid/homeostasis model): multinomial for the state head (3 classes), binary for the forward head; the same solver and objective for the native heads
readout_solver_closed_choice.objective: J(W, b) = (1/n) x sum over mask rows of negative log-likelihood of softmax/sigmoid(z_i W + b) at y_i + (lambda / 2) x sum(W**2) with lambda = 1.0; intercept b included and not penalised; no class weights; n = rows in the fit mask
readout_solver_closed_choice.solver: deterministic L-BFGS: scipy.optimize.minimize(method='L-BFGS-B') on the flattened (W, b) with analytic gradient, options maxiter 200, gtol 1e-6 (projected gradient infinity-norm), ftol 1e-9 (relative objective change), zero initialisation, float64; the exact library version and the option dictionary are recorded in the results
readout_solver_closed_choice.streaming: objective and gradient are accumulated in bounded passes over sparse-code batches of <= 1,024 rows (dense per-batch blocks only); no dense n x 2,597 matrix is materialised
readout_solver_closed_choice.reporting: termination reason, iterations, final objective, final projected-gradient norm; non-convergence (maxiter reached or abnormal termination) is reported as such and the run stops; no tuning or retry after results
readout_solver_closed_choice.probabilities_R7: outputs recorded as uncalibrated probability vectors with explicit class order: state [down, up, neutral], forward [no_event, event]; log-loss uses clipping to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6]; every metric denominator is the mask row count of that split/fold and is reported
readout_solver_closed_choice.baselines_R7: train-only class-prior constant (counted on the fit mask; no optimiser) reported next to each head; a zero-logit frozen head is reported as uniform probabilities with its deterministic argmax labelled a mechanical artefact; no chance-accuracy claim is made
readout_solver_closed_choice.metrics_removed: detection delay and warning persistence are not computed in the pilot (episode definition not frozen)

F1_state_pilot.target: S_generated_state_at_D with the declared mapping down={descent,crash}, up={ascent,rebound}, neutral={sideways,highvol}; labels read only at the preselected rows
fits: native multinomial logistic on the 10 scaled features (computed once; shared across replicates in any later study, R8)
F1_state_pilot.evaluation: confusion matrices, per-class precision/recall, macro-F1, Brier and log-loss (uncalibrated) on check and on test rows of the paired mask separately; per combination id breakdown; no threshold choice

F1_forward_pilot.target: E_close20 via council_io.label_e_close20 and gated_label under the model clocks
F1_forward_pilot.fold: 2026 only (engineering pilot, chosen now, no sweep): fit rows = paired-mask real sessions with D + 20 <= 5731 (the full 2002..2025 prefix, roughly 5,500 eligible anchors before mask losses; the exact count is recorded); scored rows = paired-mask sessions with D > 5731 and D + 20 <= data end; unscored predictions = eligible sessions with D + 20 > data end (counted)
fits: native binary logistic on the 10 scaled features

T_forward LightGBM on the 10 features: objective binary, num_leaves 7, max_depth 3, learning_rate .05, min_data_in_leaf 200, lambda_l2 1, 200 rounds, seed 0, num_threads 1, deterministic, force_col_wise; output recorded as an uncalibrated probability
F1_forward_pilot.operating_point_R1: p >= 0.5 only; no quantile rule in the pilot
F1_forward_pilot.metrics: on scored rows: positives, negatives, confusion matrix, precision, recall, false-alarm rate, warning rate at 0.5; Brier and log-loss (uncalibrated); denominators reported

F2_retrieval_pilot.queries_accepted: 8 label-blind queries = the first feature-eligible session of each year 2019..2026
F2_retrieval_pilot.candidates: real sessions s < D with E_close20 availability (model clock) <= decision_at(D), same encoder version, non-zero code, outcome {event, ret20, max_dd} from council_io labels; council_io.retrieve with k = 10, min_separation = 21, target E_close20
F2_retrieval_pilot.query_outcome: reported only if D + 20 <= data end; otherwise marked unscored
F2_retrieval_pilot.outputs: per query: cases (similarity, label_end_index, outcome, max_drawdown_in_window), similarity_spread, eligible/returned counts, measured retrieval time; descriptive comparison of retrieved event share vs realised event where scorable

budget_and_controls_R3.no_estimates: no wall-time or memory estimate is asserted before measurement; measured wall time, peak RSS and output bytes are reported from the pilot
budget_and_controls_R3.allocation_controls: before every array allocation larger than 64 MiB the code computes the byte size and aborts if the running total of live large arrays plus the new one would exceed 1.5 GiB (a soft ceiling below the 2 GiB cap); batches are bounded at 1,024 rows; one encoder variant and one head are in memory at a time; caches are flushed to disk after each path
budget_and_controls_R3.monitoring: process RSS is sampled before and after each batch, each objective/gradient pass and each fit via the OS process API; exceeding 2 GiB aborts at the next sample; the enforcement limit is stated honestly: a single allocation between two samples could overshoot briefly, which the 1.5 GiB soft ceiling is meant to prevent
budget_and_controls_R3.external_wrapper: the external runner sets thread env vars before imports, enforces the 300 s timeout and the output-byte cap, and records before/after hashes; it does not expand any budget

failure_rule: stop and report on timeout, memory or disk cap, hash mismatch, label-availability violation, hidden-file access outside the state-target builder, oversized allocation, or non-convergence; preserve partial outputs and a failure record; no automatic budget expansion, repeated fits, hyperparameter changes or sample changes

outputs.results: council_phase1_pilot_results.json written once (xb): all hashes, encoder version ids, row selections, mask counts, solver reports (library version, options, termination), metrics with denominators, F2 records, measurements, limitations

selftests_before_approval: toy connectome (6 PN, 20 KC), toy paths <= 64 rows, toy real series <= 400 rows; no real data beyond hashes and calendar
encoder determinism; version id changes when any identity component changes
rewiring preserves each KC row's input degree and weight multiset
label-blind stride sampling reproducible and independent of hidden labels
fit admissibility by availability clock at the cutoff; scored/unscored split at data end; unscored rows never negatives
paired mask applied identically to every method; counts reported
L-BFGS on a separable toy terminates with the recorded reason; analytic gradient checked against finite differences on a tiny case; non-finite objective stops
probability vectors sum to 1 with recorded class order; prior-constant baseline equals training frequencies
retrieval candidate clocks under model time; the 8 first-eligible-session queries reproducible
allocation guard and RSS monitor trigger on tiny caps in the toy run
later_study_not_in_this_document: replicates 0..4, all 12 forward folds, full state rows: 11 state fits + 144 forward fits = 155 fits; separate budget after pilot measurements
limitations_stated_in_results: no real current-trend ground truth: state heads are scored only on generated regimes under a declared mapping
forward results are one retrospective year on latest-vintage data with overlapping labels; one replicate; no significance or robustness claim
model time only; no real-date confirmation
F2 similarity is resemblance, not prediction
